listing.name: Trails of Tooth and Claw
listing.summary: v1.0 This is the initial public release of TTC v1.0, an exploration mod that adds 3 new factions somewhere out in the wilderness.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction of sapient bipedal reptiles that migrate across the sector as a rolling ecosystem.

description:
Electric Trojan | Exarl | Iryx | Joanna | Kiera | MesotroniK | Mezzelo | Onyxarias | Scrinarus

v1.3.0

DOWNLOAD

REQUIRES MAGICLIB Here

After a substantial amount of work, I'm finally ready to launch the first public version of my new mod, Trails of Tooth and Claw

At its core this is an exploration mod, so I won't be giving you a detailed rundown of all the content this mod adds. But enough time has passed since release, so for those not adverse to spoilers.

Spoiler
This mod adds three sub-factions collectively representing the Arkaran, a species of sapient bipedal reptiles, the campaign.

They have come from very far away, arriving at the sector's western border several months after the start of a campaign. Their purpose here is primarily to trade, but they are not planning to stay. During the campaign they will settle various star systems temporarily as they gradually make their way eastward across the campaign map in what I would describe as a rolling ecosystem separate from the core worlds. Eventually, once they reach the eastern border of the map, they will leave, permanently.

For now, detailed and nuanced interactions for affecting their trip through the sector are scant, and adding unique dialogue is a never-ending work in progress. But how you choose to react, or not react to their presence is entirely up to you.

This was a long time in the making, and involved many, many people in some capacity. It's still got some rough edges to polish up, and we hope to continue updating the project going forward. But for now, I hope everyone enjoys this 1.0 Release!

Also because I know people are going to ask:
- Yes, this mod functionally replaces LoA for me, the ideas I was building toward in LoA are more refined and better executed here in ways that appeal to my modern sensibilities far better than any of my long term plans for that mod ever could. I just don't have the interest in putting in the titanic amount of work it would require to continue developing content for that mod.

- No, I will not deprecate LoA, I will continue to ensure the mod continues to function through subsequent updates to the game, I just won't be developing any new content for it.

- Yes, you're allowed to be disappointed by that.

- No, it won't change my mind.

discordPostHtml:
v1.0
This is the initial public release of TTC v1.0, an exploration mod that adds 3 new factions somewhere out in the wilderness.

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=34672.msg506364#new

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UZF2Oggn7XeEC22DEpQNhHJcBqF-ow_d/view?usp=sharing
aiDescription: Introduces three sub-factions representing the Arkaran species. They arrive at the western border and gradually move eastward, settling star systems temporarily before leaving permanently. The mod focuses on exploration and player interaction with this migrating group.

gallery.aiCaption: A wide banner showing a large ship with a red engine glow against a nebula background, with the text 'TRAILS OF TOOTH AND CLAW' and 'GWYVERN NICKE'.
A wide banner showing a large ship with a red engine glow against a nebula background, with the text 'TRAILS OF TOOTH AND CLAW' and 'GWYVERN NICKE'.
A wide banner showing a large spaceship with the text 'TRAILS OF TOOTH AND CLAW' and 'GWYVERN NICKE'.
A tactical map view showing fleet movements and trails in space.
A dialogue screen featuring a lizard-like character named 'Qanya'ete Go'tic' with text about the Remainder fleet.

changelog.1.0.3:
This update should be save compatable, but many of the descriptor additions won't show up on markets present on game load, you will need to wait until they move before the descriptions show up.
 There's still more polishing up and fleshing out to do, please be patient with me and Nicke, there's quite a lot of work to do before we can start working on all new content again.
 Added a lot of the market/bar related descriptions that were missing from the initial release (The Remainder is still bugged, we're working on it)
 Added an intel event that tracks the Farms on the map, wether it was discovered by you, or the global timer reveal event.
 Fixed a crash related to the phased array weapons
 Adjusted Trail migration timing
 adjusted Subfaction market spawning values
changelog.1.0.2:
This seems to work with my own save, but I make no guarantees.

- Added Jose's last name
- Added Takaya's last name
- Reduced the number of markets available to all 3 subfactions
- Adjusted the timing and spread of Trail movements
- Fixed a bug where none of the subfactions knew any fighter LPCs whatsoever
- Fixed a bug where the Remainder would not start hostile to the player
- A number of balance tweaks to various ships and weapons, mostly nerfs this time around.
changelog.1.0.1: Fixing my internal versioning system and enabling version checker support, as well as fixing a few more bugs
